# VigilAMC

> VigilAMC is a B2B SaaS platform for fire safety Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) agencies to manage client assets, field technician inspections, compliance reporting, and renewal workflows.

## Core Product
- [Home](https://vigilamc.com): Overview of VigilAMC fire safety AMC management software.
- [Products](https://vigilamc.com/products): Full breakdown of VigilAMC software modules and solutions.
- [Features](https://vigilamc.com/features): Key capabilities including GPS and Asset Tag ID tracking, floor/zone checklists, camera photo proof, inspection logging, and compliance alerts.
- [How It Works](https://vigilamc.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step workflow for agencies, technicians, and clients.
- [AMC Solutions](https://vigilamc.com/amc): Details on fire safety Annual Maintenance Contract management.
- [Pricing](https://vigilamc.com/pricing): Subscription plans and pricing details.
- [Book a Demo](https://vigilamc.com/demo): Schedule a live product walkthrough.

## Tools & Resources
- [Extinguisher Calculator](https://vigilamc.com/tools/extinguisher-calculator): Interactive fire extinguisher requirement calculator.
- [Sample Report](https://vigilamc.com/sample-report): Example fire safety inspection and compliance report.
- [Verify Certificate](https://vigilamc.com/verify): Public verification page for VigilAMC inspection records and reports.
